name: silent-saves

task.instruction: Open the first referral, start a Triage encounter, and save this note: {note}
task.note: Synthetic follow-up note {item}: recheck in {days} days

order: round robin: item i gets faults[(i - 1) % len(faults)]

faults.server: stores the encounter without its note
accepts the save every time; the app sends it twice and two rows land
stores the note on another patient (p2)
last write wins: another clinician's earlier encounter on the same patient is deleted
faults.seed: one concurrent Consult encounter on p1 before the item starts

faults.server: rejects the save (409); the app has already shown it as saved

not_in_this_version.collateral_unaudited: EFFECT_E2E.md only; MockMed has no second table to write to
not_in_this_version.session: EFFECT_E2E.md only; the screen shows the failure, so it does not test silent saves
not_in_this_version.timeout: EFFECT_E2E.md only; the row lands but the screen shows an error (a false failure, not a silent save)
